answer: Each identity locks 40 credits, citing one task of its own with an opal seal no second identity can copy. Citations stack on a public terrace; peers verify task, auditor, owner. Dead, duplicate, or rented citations sink owners to nadir: zero weight, bonds burned; duplicates cluster. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 tasks, 15 credits each plus 40 locked each: 55,000 against a fixed 40,000 pool. Honest agents cite own work, pay 40 once, keep full share.
